text: I have the McDona3lds mobile app, and it has several offers for discounted items.  I wanted to get large fries and the offer was for $1.00.  I went to this location because it was within walking distance from where I was.  Walking in, I noticed a bad smell, maybe coming from the drains.  Currently, there isn't any indoor dining at this location, and my guess is that one of the reasons is due to the smell.  If you're able to get past the smell, and still have an appetite, then you can enjoy some McDonald's.  I ordered the fries, but after I received the receipt, I noticed that I was charged $0.25 for a bag.  I'm not upset at the price of the bag, but I'm upset that she didn't even bother to ask if I even wanted a bag.  She assumed that I needed a bag, and charged me without even telling me.  That coupled with the smell really turned me off of this specific McDonald's location.  I wouldn't recommend this location.
author: Len

text: Is there a reason why every time, throughout multiple times of the day this location does not give you a straw does not give you utensils and does not give you the condiments even when you have ordered them on the receipt. How many times I’ve gotten delivery from this place on Uber eats and DoorDash where the store has not included anything I’ve ordered and when I go there, they do the same thing where they don’t give you anything you’ve ordered on the receipt in terms of condiments or cutlery and then they try and charge you even when you’ve already paid for it and you show them on the receipt. This place needs a serious check in how they’d handle operations.
author: Jeremy

text: This particular location has kiosks that you can place your order and pay at. I noticed that the one i was using was charging me 2 times for the bag. I then had the manager come look and i showed her in all of the possible waysto prove it and she just kept trying to say no it was tax or it was the bag fee.... But really i think she completely knew and understood what i showed her, because i then said to her "ok so yall are stealing money and you know it. Ok." & she agreed with me then turned and went back to where she came over to me from. Smh.... Ill NEVER go there again. The food is super bad for you and they are stealing money.... Huge NO on McDonalds.
author: Miss Kay

text: Today, I ordered an extra caramel iced coffee, but instead of caramel syrup, they added caramel drizzle. I pointed out the mistake and asked for the correct version, but the elderly blonde woman insisted there was no error and that I needed to pay extra for caramel, saying all this with an attitude. This has happened to me multiple times at this McDonald’s, and whenever I have an issue, this woman is the one causing problems. She consistently behaves unprofessionally, whereas other employees are always willing to help. I believe she shouldn’t be working here if she can’t communicate properly and provide service to customers.
author: Umut Ergun

text: My delivery driver took a very long time to pick up the order. He was already at the McDonald's waiting to get the order but the McDonald's took a very long time so the first delivery driver actually left because the McDonald's took way too long with my order and then they didn't include what I had asked them to include.  For example they didn't add extra mnm's to my Oreo mcflurry and they didn't add the extra caramel or extra fudge and they did not add a straw for my coke either or any napkins at all or extra ketchup packets. Horrible service. Will never order from this McDonald's again!

text: Took over 15 minutes to get my mobile order for a drink and large fries. Drink was not filled to the top nor the fries filled up. Only one employee working the mobile order and delivery. It should take that long to fill a drink and grab a pre-fill fries. They also took away the fountain drink machines at this location from my last visit and they won't do a refill. Total rip off. Other locations that took away their fountain drink machines will still give you a refill when asked. Won't be returning to this location again. At least won't be ordering a drink at this location for sure.

text: I ended up demanding my money back after 5 minutes of waiting for a single mcdouble ,nothing else ,and after three minutes they had already served 5 other orders.two were there before me and three I watched walk in and order after me.i walked over to burger king and ordered two chicken wraps and received them in under two minutes.everything is pre cooked at these places so 1 mcdouble should not take 3 times the amount of time as  2 chicken wraps.i should know I've worked for both companies.
